baseline.methodology: Fresh profiles. All Electron processes; private memory and working sets in MiB. Working-set sums can double-count shared pages. Synthetic 2500-line Python files, 12 tabs, 200-paragraph Markdown and 64 MiB PCM audio. Scenario CPU is sampled over 500 ms, idle CPU over two seconds; both are divided by logical CPU count. File bytes remain local.

editing.methodology: Fresh profiles, small Markdown live split followed by 1.87 MiB plain text editing. Input-handler time is synchronous dispatch of ten synthetic input events, not physical keyboard latency. Preview latency includes the 250 ms debounce and automation observation. Memory is the sum of all Electron processes; working sets can double-count shared pages.
